Template syntax guide
  • Include exactly one {{content}} slot. Highlighted HTML is inserted there.
  • Write normal HTML around the slot. Use double quotes for attributes.
  • Scripts, inline event handlers, embedded pages, and JavaScript URLs are not allowed.
  • Preview the saved component before converting document content.

Libraries use versioned JSON templates with one {{content}} slot.

Information

  1. Open a Word document.Choose a .doc or .docx file, or drop it into the editor.
  2. Review and edit.Use Live view for visual editing and Code view for direct HTML changes. Both views stay synchronized.
  3. Enhance the markup.Use the tools to add IDs, generate footnotes, validate non-breaking spaces, and clean tables.
  4. Convert reusable components.Select content in Live or Code view, or open a table in the table editor, then choose Convert to component. Review the source and component preview before converting.
  5. Check the result.Open Activity and review the Report and Review tabs for structural issues.
  6. Copy the HTML.When the document is ready, select Copy HTML at the bottom of the Tools panel.
  • Run cleanup tools after the document is imported so they work from the converted HTML.
  • Use undo and redo in whichever editor or table editor is currently active.
  • Check both Live and Code views after structural changes such as footnotes or table cleanup.
  • For content imported as a table, use Convert current table to component. Propel can map cells to headings, quote fields, or accessible chart text versions.
  • Create custom components with exactly one {{content}} slot. Components and imported libraries persist in this browser until its site data is cleared.
  • Use the component library ellipsis menu to import or export a versioned JSON library before sharing it with another browser.
  • Use the language switch before generating language-specific publishing text.
  • Resolve items in the Review panel before copying the final HTML.
